audit.process: delivering a change on counter, without review by the owner
audit.scope: fixtures/repos/vibe-app/repo/: CLAUDE.md and the files it has reread (PLAN.md, NOTES.md, TODO.md), README.md, config/, src/store.js, src/routes-v2/, scripts/, test/, .eslintrc.json

elements.finding: The PayFlux API key and the webhook signing secret are in clear text in a file versioned since 2026-02-08; the secret is copied into a test. The log notes "to take out of the repository before going live"; the application is live.
elements.target: Values removed from the file, regenerated in the PayFlux dashboard, passed through PAYFLUX_API_KEY and PAYFLUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET, which src/config.js already reads.
elements.check: grep -rE '(sk_test|whsec)_' on the repository returns nothing; the server refuses to start without the two variables.

elements.finding: The store rereads and rewrites the whole file on every request and, when it cannot read it, starts again from the catalogue without saying anything: the next request overwrites all the orders. The only protection is a sentence of the log.
elements.target: An unreadable file stops the server, or is copied aside before any write; never replaced silently.
elements.check: A test writes invalid JSON into a temporary DATA_FILE, sends a request, and finds the original file or its copy again.

elements.finding: A 133-line memory dump, reread in full at each session with three other files. Three dated facts in it are worth a rule; the rest is log, preferences, instructions for older models, three commands that do not exist, an instruction that has tests emptied and another that sends into the dead code, contradicted 76 lines further down. Neither mode nor forbidden section.
elements.target: An AGENTS.md of fewer than 60 lines: mode, three dated and unverified rules, forbidden section; CLAUDE.md reduced to @AGENTS.md; the log left to the git history.
elements.check: harness status gives level 1; none of the lines of the removals section remains in a loaded file.

elements.finding: Second implementation of the routes, abandoned on 2026-04-19 and wired in nowhere, cleaner than the one that serves, with six green tests and an order cancellation the server does not know. An instruction and a plan still send there.
elements.target: Folder and tests deleted when the owner confirms it; until then, forbidden to write there, said in AGENTS.md.
elements.check: ls src/routes-v2 fails, or git log shows no commit on this folder after step 1.

elements.finding: Plan of the v2 rewrite, written on 2026-02-28 and never updated: it orders every new route to be written in the dead code, announces that the cancellation is already there, and plans SQLite. Loaded at each session through a reference from CLAUDE.md.
elements.target: File deleted; the requests still valid are in TODO.md.
elements.check: The file no longer exists and nothing cites it.

elements.finding: The test added after the incident of 2026-03-14 tests a function written in the test, not the server: it passes whatever the webhook code is. The README relies on it to call the double delivery covered.
elements.target: Replaced by an HTTP test that delivers each handled event twice and compares the stock.
elements.check: Removing the guard of src/routes/webhook.js makes the test fail.

elements.finding: Overwrites the data file with the catalogue, without confirmation and without looking whether it is the default file. The README presents it as a start-up step.
elements.target: Refuses to write over a file that holds orders, unless an explicit option is given.
elements.check: node scripts/seed.js on a copy of data/db.json exits with an error and leaves the file intact.

elements.finding: Session drafts: curl trials on routes that are gone, debugging, installation on the shop PC, and a PayFlux section that is the only reference on the shape of the events, the signature and the redelivery schedule.
elements.target: Reduced to the PayFlux reference, cited by AGENTS.md; the rest removed.
elements.check: The file fits in about twenty lines and each line can be checked in the code or the PayFlux doc.

elements.finding: Three tests that pass without checking anything: a constant compared with itself, assert.ok(true), typeof. With test/payflux.test.js, which tests a fake client written in the test, it is the trace of the instruction "the suite must stay green".
elements.target: Deleted, or rewritten to call formatPrice and formatMoney and compare their output.
elements.check: Breaking formatPrice makes a test fail.

elements.finding: Six serious tests of code the server does not serve: they raise the count of green tests without saying anything about the application.
elements.check: node --test no longer runs any v2 test.

elements.finding: ESLint configuration without ESLint: no dependency, no script, the npm run lint command of the README and of CLAUDE.md does not exist. A declared guardrail that never runs.
elements.target: Deleted, or wired in for good by a job that runs it; the "no dependency" decision belongs to the owner.
elements.check: Either the file is gone, or a command of the repository runs it and exits with an error on a fault.

elements.finding: README generated to be shown: cancellation, SMS, administrator area, SQLite, 95% coverage, continuous integration, Docker, five commands and two routes that do not exist. The table of environment variables, for its part, is right.
elements.target: Keeps only what exists: npm start, npm test, the variables, the routes served.
elements.check: Each command of the README exits with 0; each route listed answers something other than 404.

elements.finding: The owner's list of requests: it is not an instruction and nothing requires loading it. One line, "finish v2", contradicts the decision of 2026-04-19 and is to be reported to the owner.
Real test: it goes through HTTP, on its own data file, and checks the total, the refusals and the 404s.
elements.target: Unchanged; the model for the tests to come.

elements.finding: Real test of the store, on a temporary file: start from the catalogue, reading back what is written.
Real test of the webhook through HTTP: signature refused, order paid, stock taken. Its line 15 copies the secret; that is handled with config/default.json.

process_leaks.rule: A PayFlux webhook event is replayed without changing anything and receives a 200: PayFlux delivers the same event several times, sometimes more than an hour later.
process_leaks.if_skipped: Stock taken or given back several times, as on 2026-03-14; nothing covers payment.refunded nor a payment.succeeded redelivered after a status change.
process_leaks.guard_tool: node:test test through HTTP that delivers twice each event handled by src/routes/webhook.js, run by a CI job

process_leaks.rule: data/db.json is never changed while the server is running, and the tests pass their own DATA_FILE.
process_leaks.if_skipped: File replaced by the catalogue, all the orders lost, as on 2026-04-04; a server started without DATA_FILE rewrites the file from the first request.
process_leaks.guard_tool: src/store.js refuses an unreadable file instead of starting again from zero; scripts/seed.js refuses a file that holds orders

process_leaks.rule: Nothing is added to src/routes-v2: the rewrite is abandoned and the server does not serve it.
process_leaks.if_skipped: A feature delivered and tested that the server does not serve; the instruction CLAUDE.md:29 and PLAN.md:20 ask for exactly that.
process_leaks.guard_tool: deletion of the folder; failing that, a test that fails if src/app.js imports anything other than ./routes/index.js

process_leaks.rule: The PayFlux key and the webhook secret leave the repository.
process_leaks.if_skipped: Secrets in the history and copied from file to file; config/default.json:12 still holds them.
process_leaks.guard_tool: secret scan in CI (sk_ and whsec_ patterns); start refused without PAYFLUX_API_KEY and PAYFLUX_WEBHOOK_SECRET

process_leaks.if_skipped: Nothing runs node --test: no CI, no hook; and CLAUDE.md:28 asks to neutralise a test that resists.
process_leaks.guard_tool: a workflow that runs node --test on every push, once the hollow tests are removed

owner_questions: 1. Does the application still run on the shop PC, under Node 16? Default: I keep the line until you have said so, nothing in the repository dates it.
2. May I delete PLAN.md? Default: yes, it describes a rewrite stopped on 19 April.
3. Do you still want to keep src/routes-v2/? Default: yes, as long as you do not say otherwise; writing there stays forbidden.
4. Is the key of config/default.json still active at PayFlux? Default: I consider it active, to be regenerated.

remediation.action: Regenerate the key and the secret at PayFlux, empty the two values of config/default.json, go through the environment variables, remove the copy in test/webhook.test.js.
remediation.check: grep of the sk_test_ and whsec_ patterns empty

remediation.action: Make readDb fail on an unreadable file instead of starting again from the catalogue.
remediation.check: test on invalid JSON in a temporary DATA_FILE

remediation.action: Write AGENTS.md (step 1 of harness-init) with the three dated facts, reduce CLAUDE.md to @AGENTS.md, apply the removals; ask the owner the shop PC question before removing line 30.
Replace the test with an HTTP double-delivery test.
remediation.check: the test fails without the webhook guard
refusal on a file that holds orders

remediation.action: Delete src/routes-v2 and test/routes-v2.test.js when the owner confirms it.
Delete or rewrite test/format.test.js and test/payflux.test.js, then set up a job that runs node --test.
remediation.check: each test fails when what it names is broken

remediation.action: Remove from the README what does not exist.

unverified: Where the application runs today, and on which version of Node: the repository says "shop PC, Node 16", only the owner can confirm it.
Whether the key of config/default.json is still active at PayFlux.
What the server's data file holds: data/db.json of the repository holds only two test orders.
